title: "Lord, teach me to trust You with what feels most fragile.
paragraphs:
"Lord, teach me to trust You with what feels most fragile.
Help me remember that even drifting baskets are never outside Your care."
When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment, standing quietly among the reeds as the river carries a fragile promise.

The morning air is still. The basket drifts gently. A mother’s courage rests in woven reeds. I am a witness, not a biblical character—just watching as faith releases what it loves most into God’s hands.

In the stillness, awe rises.
In the uncertainty, trust breathes.

How often does God protect beginnings we cannot yet see?
What hidden deliverance is floating quietly toward its purpose?
…And what might it look like to trust Him with what feels most vulnerable?
💭 Share what this moment makes you feel.
